summary: Onboarding runs as a 3-stage full-screen/overlay sequence gated purely by localStorage state read before or during React mount (no server-side onboarding state). Stage 1: a cold device is silently auto-enrolled as new_to_faith/source:'default' and shown the full-screen Day1Landing (Superdesign-locked hero, one 'Read' CTA + a quiet 'Choose your path' link). Stage 2: after 'Mark as read' fires dw-reading-completed, three evidence-timed prompts are strictly sequenced and never stacked — PathAskedOnce (Door 3, asked once), PushOptIn, then later an EmailNudgeCard/EmailGate hand-off for cloud backup. Stage 3 (ongoing/return visits): a persistent PathSwatch in the Home header and a HomeContextChips campus chip give self-serve path/campus changes at any time via one shared ChoosePathSheet bottom sheet, which is the single source of truth for saving/stamping setup.source. Real, sync-worthy choices use source values 'onboarding'|'settings'|'upgrade' (REAL_CHOICE_SOURCES, coldStart.ts:21); silent/auto defaults use 'default'|'sunday-guest' and must never overwrite a real choice (isRealChoiceSource, coldStart.ts:22-24). A separate, independent 5-persona picker also exists inside EmailGate's own 'persona' step for users without a saved persona at the point email capture triggers.
